info.name: ZyraTech Hub API Collection
info.description: Complete API collection for ZyraTech Hub with 19 modules and 100+ endpoints. All sensitive values replaced with placeholders for security compliance.

variable.description: Base API URL - Include https:// protocol
Base URL without /api suffix (for health check endpoint)

item.name: 0. Health Check
item.description: System health and status endpoints

request.description: Check if the ZyraTech Hub API is running and healthy. Returns server status and environment information.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: User authentication, JWT tokens, OAuth, 2FA, and password management endpoints

request.description: Create a new user account. Returns JWT token and user profile on successful registration. Token is automatically saved to environment.

exec: console.log('✅ Access token saved to environment!');

request.description: Authenticate user with email and password. Returns JWT access token, refresh token, and user profile. Token is automatically saved to environment.

exec: console.log('✅ Access token saved to environment!');

request.description: Retrieve current authenticated user information. Requires valid JWT token.
Generate a new JWT access token using a valid refresh token. Refresh tokens have longer expiration. New token is automatically saved to environment.

exec: console.log('✅ New access token saved to environment!');

request.description: Logout user and invalidate current JWT token. User must login again to access protected resources.
Request password reset. Sends reset link to provided email address. Link expires after 1 hour.
Reset password using token from password reset email. Token must be valid and not expired.
Change authenticated user's password. Requires providing current password and new password.
Verify email address using token sent to email. Required for full account access.
Resend email verification token if original was lost or expired.
Enable two-factor authentication (TOTP) for account security. Returns QR code and backup codes.
Verify two-factor authentication code during login. 6-digit code from authenticator app.
Disable two-factor authentication for account. Requires verification code.
Authenticate using Google OAuth. Creates account if user doesn't exist.
Authenticate using GitHub OAuth. Creates account if user doesn't exist.
Authenticate using LinkedIn OAuth. Creates account if user doesn't exist.
Update authenticated user's profile information including name, phone, bio, and avatar.
Update user's notification preferences for various notification types.
Generate 2FA setup QR code and backup codes before enabling 2FA.
Get list of all active sessions for current user.
Revoke all active sessions for current user. Logs out from all devices.
Revoke a specific session by ID. Logs out that session only.
Submit KYC (Know Your Customer) documents for identity verification.

item.name: 2. User Management
item.description: Admin user management, profile updates, KYC verification, and account controls

request.description: Get current authenticated user's profile information.
Update current user's profile information including name, phone, bio, and avatar.
Get specific user profile by ID (admin only). Includes full user details and status.
List all users with pagination and filtering (admin only). Supports filtering by role and status.
Create new admin user (super admin only). User must change temporary password on first login.
Update user role and department (super admin only). Changes user permissions accordingly.
Deactivate user account (admin only). Account can be reactivated later.
Permanently delete user account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.

item.description: Course management, listings, and CRUD operations for training modules

request.description: List all public training courses with pagination and filtering. No authentication required.
Get detailed information about a specific course including curriculum and instructors.

item.name: 4. Training Applications/Enrollments
item.description: Student enrollment management and course application tracking

request.description: Enroll student in a training course. Creates pending enrollment awaiting payment.
Get all courses current user is enrolled in with enrollment status and progress.
Get detailed information about a specific enrollment including progress tracking.
Unenroll from a course. Removes access to course materials immediately.
